# Maggie Dent

> > Expert parenting guidance and child development resources from renowned Australian parenting educator Maggie Dent, covering resilience-building, behavioral challenges, and family relationships.

Maggie Dent is a leading Australian parenting expert, author, and podcast host who provides evidence-based parenting advice and resources for families raising children. Her site serves as a comprehensive hub for parents and educators seeking guidance on child development, emotional wellbeing, and family relationships.

## Key Topics

- Child development
- Parenting strategies
- Resilience building
- Child behavior management
- Emotional wellbeing
- Family relationships
- Early childhood
- Adolescence
- Social skills & bullying
- Anxiety & emotional regulation
- Discipline & positive parenting
- Parental As Anything
- Mothering Our Boys
- Podcast host
- Australian parenting expert

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://www.maggiedent.com): Maggie Dent's homepage offering parenting resources and resilience guidance.
- [About Maggie](https://www.maggiedent.com/about-maggie): Biography of parenting expert Maggie Dent and her published works.
- [Common Parenting Concerns](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns): Hub for parenting advice covering common behavioral and emotional concerns.

## Parenting Guidance by Topic

- [Building Resilience](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/building-resilience): Resilience-building strategies and resources for children birth to 12 years.
- [Early Years, Babies & Toddlers](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/early-years): Parenting resources for babies, toddlers, and early childhood development.
- [Anger, Self-regulation & Tantrums](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/anger-self-regulation-tantrums): Parenting guide on managing anger and tantrums with calming strategies.
- [Anxiety & Fear / Calming Children](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/anxiety-fear-calming-children): Guidance on childhood anxiety with mindfulness and calming techniques.
- [Discipline & Challenging Behaviour](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/discipline-challenging-behaviour): Positive discipline strategies for managing challenging child behavior.
- [Children's Temperaments: Roosters & Lambs](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/childrens-temperaments-roosters-lambs): Framework for understanding different child temperaments and behaviors.
- [Building Family Relationships](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/building-family-relationships): Parenting guide to strengthening family bonds and fatherhood.
- [Friendships, Social Skills & Bullying](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/friendships-social-bullying): Resources on social skills, bullying prevention, and friendship building.
- [Learning Issues & Motivation](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/learning-motivation): Parenting strategies for learning challenges and school motivation.
- [Play & Nature Play](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/play-nature-play): Guide on importance of play and nature for child development.

## Sensitive Topics & Life Challenges

- [Body Safety / Talking Sex](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/body-safety-sex): Age-appropriate guide to body safety, consent, and sex education.
- [Death & Loss](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/death-loss): Support guide for helping children understand and cope with grief.
- [Family Breakdown & Sibling Rivalry](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/family-breakdown-sibling-rivalry): Guidance on managing sibling rivalry and family separation issues.
- [Drugs & Alcohol](https://www.maggiedent.com/common-concerns/drugs-alcohol): Parenting guide on substance abuse education and teen health.

## Support & Help

- [Support Services Directory](https://www.maggiedent.com/support-services): Directory of mental health and family support services including helplines.
- [FAQs / Help](https://www.maggiedent.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about shop, shipping, and payment methods.
